votes.context: Mrs. Miller moved to approve the minutes for the Council meeting on September 21, 2026, as written, and Mr. Nation seconded.

Ordinance No. 2026-043 Authorizing the Village Manager and Finance Director to Establish a Village Credit Card Account with Peoples Bank and to Enroll the Village in the Insured Cash Sweep (ICS) Service Through Peoples Bank and Declaring an Emergency . Mrs. Miller moved to waive the two-reading rule for Ordinance 2026-043, and Mr. Gallagher seconded the motion.
Mr. Nation moved to adopt Ordinance 2026-043 as an emergency, and Mr. Colvin seconded the motion.
